versions.changelog:
cjournal-analyzer 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive CSSCI (C刊) journal analysis tool.
- Automatically fetches the last 5 years of all articles, authors, and abstracts from CNKI for a specified journal.
- Generates a professional Word report covering topic trends, keyword frequency, research methods, core authors, column analysis, research gaps, and submission advice.
- Incorporates browser automation for data collection, progress reporting, and user-friendly handling of CNKI verification steps.
- Includes Python-based data analysis with visualizations and structured Word report output.
